newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds start quietly easier.
newsitem.headline: European feeds start quietly easier.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started the day quietly with sellers offering South American soymeal pellets between unchanged for nearby positions to $4 down for more distant material, following last night's Chicago soymeal futures close, market sources said.
Most other products were quoted unchanged to $1 lower on the back of a strong dollar. No trades were reported during the ealy stages of the market.
"With a public holiday in the Netherlands on Wednesday and a large part of Europe closed on Thursday for May Day there is little buying interest seen," one broker said.
